answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the bridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the ripple of a task receipt, and the orchard is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
